summary: Frontend-only verification of the new editorial GallerySection on landing. All 9 acceptance criteria PASS (21/21 Playwright assertions, 0 failures). Section renders with data-testid='gallery-section' between DogDifferenceSection and the 'Inside the cabin' bedroom block — verified via getBoundingClientRect.top: dog-difference=4157px < gallery=5508px < 'Wake up to the lake' h2=8380px. All 13 tiles present by data-testid (signature-exterior, pool-twilight, dog-park-2, signature-interior, monolith-exterior, treat-bar-suite, human-spa, grooming-salon, wash-station, shower, play-lounge, lobby, dog-park). Every img is .complete and naturalWidth > 0 (range 896–1600px native). Lightbox opens on tile click (data-testid='gallery-lightbox'), closes via close button (data-testid='gallery-lightbox-close') AND via dark backdrop click. Mobile (375×800): all 4 sampled tiles render at 327px width = single-column stack. Smoke: /booking loads (title 'PawHaus Resort — Founders Pre-Booking', body contains petite/standard/monolith/promo); /admin loads. Console: only 3 benign '@import rules are not allowed here' warnings (CSS import in JS string — pre-existing, app-wide, not gallery-related). Screenshots captured at desktop and mobile — visual editorial layout matches the intended 5-row asymmetric magazine grid; captions sit over a bottom gradient scrim and are legible.
critical_code_review_comments: GallerySection.jsx tile sub-caption is hidden by default (opacity-0 -translate-y-1) and only revealed on group-hover. On TOUCH devices (mobile/tablet) there is no hover, so the sub-line ('Off-leash zoomies. Splash pool. Shade sails.' etc.) is effectively invisible — only the bold label shows. Consider revealing sub on tap/active state for mobile, or making sub always-visible at sm breakpoint and below. Non-blocking, but the editorial copy is wasted on ~50% of traffic.

Lightbox traps focus only visually — no Escape-key handler and no focus return to the originating tile. Add a useEffect with keydown ('Escape' → setLightbox(null)) and ref-based focus restoration for a11y. Currently a keyboard user opening the lightbox cannot close it without a mouse.

Lightbox has no loading state / spinner; on slow networks users see a blank black backdrop with the close X until the full-res webp arrives. Consider preloading via the moment lightbox state is set, or showing a low-res blurhash. Minor UX nit.
Tile uses

GallerySection mounts all 13 webp images even when not in viewport — 12 use loading='lazy' (good) but the first 3 (signature-exterior, pool-twilight, dog-park-2) are priority/eager. Since the gallery sits ~5500px down the page, eager-loading 3 large images (1600px native) on landing wastes ~600KB of initial transfer for users who never scroll there. Recommend dropping priority=true on all 3 and letting native lazy do its job.
